source_text.body:
Monitor construction project risk and alert the lead
A builder made an n8n and Gemini watchdog that checks schedules, budgets, procurement, labor, weather and site reports, finds the main bottleneck, and alerts the project lead.
·
Oct 4, 2026
Done with
N8
n8n
GE
Gemini
What they did
The builder set up an n8n workflow with Gemini that pulls data on schedules, budgets, procurement, labor, weather, and site reports. The agent calculates overall project risk on its own, identifies the largest bottleneck, and sends an alert to the project lead.
How it went
No results, metrics, or shortfalls are stated.
Try it yourself
with
n8n
Copy prompt
Build an n8n workflow that every [day/week] pulls data from [schedule, budget, procurement, labor, weather, and site report sources] for [project name]. Have Gemini identify the single biggest risk or bottleneck and explain why in three sentences. Send that summary to [project lead's email or Slack channel] after showing me a sample alert for approval.
Original source: https://x.com/iamvaarr/status/2106738663883497743
